description: Which Medicare Part D formularies changed this month? Drugs added or dropped, tier, prior-authorization, step-therapy and quantity-limit changes and plan premium changes, computed by Distill from CMS’s monthly formulary files. Change records between consecutive monthly CMS Part D formulary files of a plan year: a drug (RxCUI) added to or dropped from a formulary, its tier, prior authorization, step therapy or quantity limit changed; a plan added or dropped, its premium, deductible or formulary changed. Each record cites the sha256 of both files. Pages of up to 100, oldest first; pass next_cursor back as cursor. Updated monthly. Price: $0.05 per call. Free tier: 3 free calls a day per IP, at most 3 rows per answer, taken by an unpaid call unless its _meta["distill/free-tier"] is "skip". Confidence: Freshness only (the plans and terms are read from the CMS file deterministically): 1 until 45 days after the served file’s date (CMS posts one a month), then halving every 30 days. Medicare Part D formulary and plan data as of the CMS public use file’s date (file_date), processed by Distill; the Medicare Plan Finder (medicare.gov/plan-compare) may have newer information. Not enrollment, coverage or medical advice; confirm with the plan. See /terms.

key.description: A plan (H0028-063-000), an RxCUI (all formularies) or <formulary id>:<RxCUI>.

plan_year.description: The plan (benefit) year, e.g. 2027 for open enrollment (default: the current year).

since.description: Only records detected after this time (ISO 8601).
